name: PCPr
summary: PCPr is an arylcyclohexylamine dissociative anesthetic drug with hallucinogenic and stimulant effects. It is around the same potency as phencyclidine, although slightly less potent than the ethyl homologue eticyclidine, and has reportedly been sold as a designer drug in Germany and other European countries since the late 1990s.

pharmacology.text: PCPr is an arylcyclohexylamine dissociative anesthetic drug with hallucinogenic and stimulant effects.

uses.text: PCPr is an arylcyclohexylamine dissociative anesthetic drug with hallucinogenic and stimulant effects. It is around the same potency as phencyclidine, although slightly less potent than the ethyl homologue eticyclidine, and has reportedly been sold as a designer drug in Germany and other European countries since the late 1990s.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Dissociatives of its class can cause confusion, loss of coordination, nausea, raised blood pressure, agitation and a frightening sense of detachment.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的解離劑類藥物可能造成意識混亂、協調能力喪失、噁心、血壓上升、躁動，以及令人恐懼的脫離感。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的解离剂类药物可能造成意识混乱、协调能力丧失、恶心、血压上升、躁动，以及令人恐惧的脱离感。

fact.en: It is PCP with a propyl chain in place of the piperidine ring, one of a set of such compounds made in the 1960s and 1970s to map which part of the molecule does what.
fact.zh: 它是把 PCP 的哌啶環換成丙基鏈的產物，屬於 1960 至 1970 年代為了釐清分子各部位作用而合成的一系列化合物之一。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 PCP 的哌啶环换成丙基链的产物，属于 1960 至 1970 年代为了厘清分子各部位作用而合成的一系列化合物之一。
